HRA Analysis: EL BANDOLERO (1) trialled up nicely recently in a trial taken out by smart pacer Greased Lightning where this colt ran through the line nicely into fourth running down Benny late who has shown ability when staying in a trot. He has a big handicap advantage on key rivals in this race and could prove hard to run down. SUNDAY SWEET TALK (6) has been very impressive since debuting remaining undefeated in three career starts so far. This looks her biggest test in this race facing a 30m handicap but she does have plenty of ability and can look to make it four in a row. IM FRANKEE (7) has come up short in recent outings behind SUNDAY SWEET TALK (6) who has had the handicap advantage over her. She now starts just 10m behind her in this race and should be right in the finish again. POZZI TONOZZI (5) has been racing well but just hasn’t quite been able to match it with SUNDAY SWEET TALK (6) or IM FRANKEE (7) finishing third on all three occasions. She can run on into the money again in this race but does look likely to find a couple better. SELECTIONS: EL BANDOLERO (1), SUNDAY SWEET TALK (6), IM FRANKEE (7), POZZI TONOZZI (5) SUGGESTED BET: EL BANDOLERO (1) to win.

LOCHINVAR SON (4) made an uncharacteristic break last time out which took him out of play there. He had a tough run two starts ago when finishing second to the in-form Moreep who has been able to win again since. ITS ALL RIGHT NOW (5) was able to secure a good run off the speed last time out and ran over the top to score a nice win over Gait With Grace. She meets a similar field and if she can settle close enough she should be hard to beat again. BLACK VIPER (6) was well beaten last time out in a race which wasn’t run to suit when getting back and running on into sixth. If he can do things right again in this race and the race is run to suit he can be getting into it late. PROPELLED PRINCESS (1) sat without cover last time out and battled on reasonably there for seventh. She is well handicapped in this race and if she can step safely and settle close she has claims in this race. SELECTIONS: LOCHINVAR SON (4), ITS ALL RIGHT NOW (5), BLACK VIPER (6), PROPELLED PRINCESS (1) SUGGESTED BET: LOCHINVAR SON (4) to win.

BEACH MAGIC (6) has good gate speed and may look to press forward in the early stages of this gate from a wide draw. He got back in the run last time out and was running on late into seventh not beaten too far behind Threentwo. ASCOT ANNIE (1) has always been best suited when racing on the pegs close to the speed and looks suited in this race. She had no luck in her latest outing at Marburg when badly checked before taking no competitive part there. She can bounce back. ROSIE POLLEN (7) looks likely to be shuffled back from the wide draw in this race. She got back and ran on nicely two starts ago behind The Real Rocketman. She should be running on well again in this race. SKIPPERS SWAN SONG (8) appears likely to get a good run through on the pegs in this race to settle close enough behind the speed. SELECTIONS: BEACH MAGIC (6), ASCOT ANNIE (1), ROSIE POLLEN (7), SKIPPERS SWAN SONG (8) SUGGESTED BET: ASCOT ANNIE (1) each way.

WAIKAKA MAGIC (4) has good gate speed and may be able to work his way to the lead in the early stages of this race. He was seemingly a touch disappointing on return last time out when struggling to keep up with the second last competitive horse Moonshine Milly. He is likely to have derived benefit from the outing and could just be a better horse up on speed. ILOVEACALENDARGIRL (5) took on a strong trial which was taken out by subsequent Be Good Johnny Sprint winner Final Deadline. She draws quite awkwardly in this race and may be better suited over the 1660 but does have class on her side. AMAMI (6) draws awkwardly in this race but has been racing well. He didn’t have much luck last time out in a strong race taken out by Vinke B when sustaining a flat tyre. He can be driven aggressively and should be hard to beat. O B LEGAL (1) burned hard early last time out to hold his position in a race the winner rated a flying 1.50.9. He has an excellent record over the 2138 and should settle close to the speed in this race. He can be running on late. SELECTIONS: WAIKAKA MAGIC (4), ILOVEACALENDARGIRL (5), AMAMI (6), O B LEGAL (1) SUGGESTED BET: O B LEGAL (1) each way.

ITS A SPONGE DARL (8) should get a good run through behind a gate speed horse likely to be keen to hold a forward position in this race. He sat without cover last time out and battled on well there for second behind Diego Delgado who was able to lead all the way at this track. She may need a touch of luck but should be hard to hold out if that comes her way. CARLY PEREZ (10) got it wrong a few times through the last portion of the race when not working off the inside into the clear before being badly held up late in a race she appeared to be a near good thing beaten. She draws to do no work in this race and should be running on well late again. NEED NOT TO WARRY (9) looks suited in this race getting a soft run off the speed. He got back in the run last time out and was running on into fourth late behind Needareason who raced behind the leader in the run. SKYLAR BREE (1) has good gate speed and from an ideal draw she can hold a prominent position in this race. After sitting without cover and battling on well for third she looks ready to run a big race from the draw. SELECTIONS: ITS A SPONGE DARL (8), CARLY PEREZ (10), NEED NOT TO WARRY (9), SKYLAR BREE (1) SUGGESTED BET: CARLY PEREZ (10) to win.

MAJOR SLIP UP (4) was able to press forward last time out and find the pegs before being crossed running a good third behind Diego Delgado. If he could press forward and find the lead in this race he would likely be very hard to run down. SAINT LOUIS BEAT (1) has good gate speed and should be able to lead before having options from there. He seems to be a horse best suited when sat up and saved for one run and looked to be suited last time out when running on strongly into second behind Courageous Leo. ITS BACK PAGE NEWS (6) pressed forward early last time out and was forced to race without cover there battling on strongly for a good third behind Wicked Mack. She looks to draw a touch awkwardly in this race but does have gate speed and can look to press forward again. MILLIONDOLLAR KISS (10) secured a good run off the speed last time out and was running on late into fifth. She should get a similar run in this race and can be running on if the race is run to suit. SELECTIONS: MAJOR SLIP UP (4), SAINT LOUIS BEAT (1), ITS BACK PAGE NEWS (6), MILLIONDOLLAR KISS (10) SUGGESTED BET: SAINT LOUIS BEAT (1) to win.

OUR ULTIMATE MILLY (1) was able to lead three starts ago at Redcliffe over the 2040 and took them all the way there beating Rock Nien. She is likely better suited over the shorter journey and should be able to give them something to catch again in this race. MITCHELLS RUN (8) looks likely to get an ideal run through in the early stages of this race behind the speed. He was a last start winner when finding the front at Redcliffe and taking them all way there. MAYWYN TROUBADOUR (7) led two starts ago rating good time when run down late by Sweet Lad Jujon who had the perfect run on his back there. He backed that up with another good run finishing fourth behind Magnetic Storm. GLENLEDI BOY (2) draws well in this race and should settle close to the speed in this race. He got back in the run last time out and was running on reasonably not beaten too far into sixth behind Cedar Creek Falls. SELECTIONS: OUR ULTIMATE MILLY (1), MITCHELLS RUN (8), MAYWYN TROUBADOUR (7), GLENLEDI BOY (2) SUGGESTED BET: OUR ULTIMATE MILLY (1) to win.

DIEGO DELGADO (4) found the front last time out at this track and was able to hold off the challenge of Its A Sponge Darl who raced without cover. If he was able to find the front again in this race he would likely be quite hard to run down. PENNIE PACKER (1) has good gate speed and should be able to hold a prominent position from the perfect draw in this race. She secured a good run last time out and didn’t quite finish the race off there when running fifth. She should get every chance. SCOTTIE MACH (8) should get a good run through in this race behind a gate speed horse. He has been well beaten in recent outings fading late after attempting to get into it out wider on the track but could get a big improver in this race getting back onto the pegs. MY ULTIMATE COSSIE (10) has been racing in good form and seems to appreciate racing over this track and trip. He looked a touch unlucky in his latest outing when running into second when eventually clear behind Bettor Be Bohdi. SELECTIONS: DIEGO DELGADO (4), PENNIE PACKER (1), SCOTTIE MACH (8), MY ULTIMATE COSSIE (10) SUGGESTED BET: SCOTTIE MACH (8) each way. OVERVIEW:PATNWILL (3) is racing well and has great gate speed, so he should be able to map well here. He led and won well last start at Echuca. An eye-catching horse in that same race was JAKEE BOY (6). He sustained a strong three-wide run and hit the line nicely for second. He has the best sectional times in this race, but he can get it wrong with his manners and has a sticky barrier here. MI BOW (4) hasn’t had much luck recently. Two starts ago, she looked to be getting home well but had no clear running. Last start, she just got too far back and didn’t run home as well. At her best, and with some luck, she’s an each-way play here. ROBERT JOHN (7) will need to overcome barrier seven, but he is racing well. His run two starts ago was especially impressive, flashing home well for second. With the right run, he has the ability to win and should be nearer to peak fitness here. CHILLHUNNYBUNNY (1) should get a good trip from barrier one and rarely runs a bad race. SELECTIONS: PATNWILL (3), JAKEE BOY (6), MI BOW (4), ROBERT JOHN (7)

OVERVIEW:COGNAC COWBOY (10) has the best sectional times in this event on exposed form. His two runs back this preparation have been good. Two runs back, he sustained a strong, long run from well back for second, and last start he used the sprint lane and was narrowly beaten for second. He will need some luck from the barrier. LIGHTNING ORO (5) is a first starter for up-and-coming trainer Lochie Cook. We will learn more about the horse here, but he was a nice second in a recent Terang trial. BETTORS IDEAL (8) won that same Terang trial and looks to be a quality first starter for Gary and Darryl Lawlor. He’s a half-brother to one of the fastest mares in the state, Sweet Ideal. It will be a big ask to navigate an inexperienced horse to victory from barrier eight at Ballarat, where there is no sprint lane. However, on breeding and trial form, he has the capability. SIR KITT (3) has flashed home well to place in his last two starts behind classy getaway leaders. He looks well placed here. CRYPTO CROOK (7) is an interesting runner. He sprinted home impressively for second on debut but got it wrong with his manners last start. He is having his third start here and clearly has ability. SELECTIONS: COGNAC COWBOY (10), LIGHTNING ORO (5), BETTORS IDEAL (8), SIR KITT (3)

OVERVIEW: This is a race where we have to take a lot of these horses on trust, as they can get it wrong with their manners. ITALIAN THUNDER (4) is a well-bred gelding who is first-up here for new trainer Colin Holloway. He has got it wrong with his manners in his three career starts, but he has shown glimpses of nice ability, including in his trials before he started racing. He needs to trot here. BIRMINGHAM GIRL (3) has had three career starts. She has sprinted home impressively late in two of her runs. In the other, she didn’t want a bar of trotting. She has ability and is looking to give Jodie Justice her first career win. GATESYS DELIGHT (2) has had two career starts. She finished third on debut but didn’t look safe in her trotting action. She looked better last start at Shepparton when second after a fence trip. Likely to improve again. BREDBY BRUCE (1) is a first starter with a good barrier and okay trial form. SELECTIONS: ITALIAN THUNDER (4), BIRMINGHAM GIRL (3), GATESYS DELIGHT (2), BREDBY BRUCE (1)

OVERVIEW:RIDDLEMETHIS (3) is in great form and hasn’t missed a place in his four starts this preparation. He is a great swooper and, if he is close enough, he will be the one to watch late. ONYX (8) has the best sectional times in this event and is the only horse on the back row, so has the option to get off the fence. Looking to give Chelsie O'Driscoll her first training win. NORMANDY NUGGET (1) has been racing super and has great gate speed. He should be able to capitalise on the ace barrier. HOME AND DRY (2) is racing a bit better than his numerical form suggests. He is a nice horse but will rely on luck. BACK: RIDDLEMETHIS (3)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: RIDDLEMETHIS (3), ONYX (8), NORMANDY NUGGET (1), HOME AND DRY (2)

OVERVIEW:KING KASEY (1) is in excellent form. He has good gate speed and the ace barrier to use to his advantage here. He is a smart horse who is best in front. That’s how he has won his last three starts and he will likely be the leader again here. COLOSIMO (6) is another horse in great form who has won his last two starts. He has a lot of ability and a nice turn of foot, but this barrier is sticky. GOODTIME LIBBY (5) is a fast mare. She may try to cross to the front early here with her great gate speed or wait for one run. The barrier is awkward for her, but the stable is flying. MAJOR DRAMA (3) is a mare full of confidence and in career-best form. She will need luck here, but she’s racing very well. BACK: KING KASEY (1) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: KING KASEY (1), COLOSIMO (6), GOODTIME LIBBY (5), MAJOR DRAMA (3)

OVERVIEW:STORM VENDETTA (7) is a smart, high-speed three-year-old. He has good gate speed and used that speed to find the front and lead all the way last start. He should be able to find the front here again, even from the sticky barrier. FIVE CENT (3) made up ground wide and late last start at Ararat. He has a nice turn of foot and is a versatile type, but may still need a bit of luck here. SIR NIPPA (5) is second-up here, so expecting an improved run with added fitness. He just got way too far back last start, but it wasn’t a bad run. He is returning from a preparation in Tasmania, but he was last year's Stawell Cup winner. TOPHUT JOHNY (2) is an experienced horse and a 32-time winner. He isn’t in career-best form, but if he can map well, he won't be far away. Also noting trotter NEPHEW OF SONOKO (6) is taking on the pacers here. It’s hard to line up his form, but on the clock he has the slowest recent sectional times. BACK: STORM VENDETTA (7) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: STORM VENDETTA (7), FIVE CENT (3), SIR NIPPA (5), TOPHUT JOHNY (2)

OVERVIEW:CLAUDYS HERO (5) has always promised to be a talented trotter. He just can get it wrong with his manners and gallops often for no reason. If he trots throughout, he is a big winning chance. He is first-up here for Alex Ashwood. THE SKY IS THE LIMIT (2) is a mare who is racing well. If she can find the fence here, she will be right in it late. DISTANT SUN (1) flashed home impressively for second two starts ago at Maryborough. Last start, she got the perfect fence trip but just didn’t let down as well late. At her best, she’s a nice chance here. DELS DESTINY (3) is a good swooper and, with the right run, will be flashing home late. He’s suited by the smaller field as he can't get too far back. SELECTIONS: CLAUDYS HERO (5), THE SKY IS THE LIMIT (2), DISTANT SUN (1), DELS DESTINY (3)

OVERVIEW: This is another event where the key contenders need to be taken with some risk due to their manners. EMMWALLEN (6) is a smart trotter, but he can gallop and do things wrong. He has the best sectional times in this event. He was outstanding last start at Kilmore, flashing home from last to finish second. If he does everything right, he’s a big chance here. KISS AT MIDNIGHT (5) is another trotter that can do things wrong. Last start, she led, took a sit and was too good late, flashing home to win well. She does have some gate speed and, if she trots throughout, she’s another key contender. YETTI (7) is very lightly raced, with only four career starts since June 2025. He has galloped in every start. Last start, when first-up, he galloped early, recovered, caught the field and let down impressively to win. Manners are key. CALABASAS (3) performed well below her best last start. A follow-up veterinary report indicated an abnormal white cell count. Connections wouldn’t be racing her unless she was back to her best health-wise. She is a nice mare with ability when she puts it all together. BACK: EMMWALLEN (6) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: EMMWALLEN (6), KISS AT MIDNIGHT (5), YETTI (7), CALABASAS (3)

OVERVIEW:PRETTY BASIC (2) is third-up here, so expecting him to be closer to his best. He was well back last start at Ararat but sprinted home nicely along the sprint lane for third. If he can get some luck, he’s likely to improve on that run. BLUE CANNON (3) won his last start at Shepparton. He got a perfect trip and sprinted home impressively to win. He will benefit from a bit of luck here. WINGATE GUY (5) rarely runs a bad race. He has been flashing home well each start, but he’s just been too far back. SWIM SUIT (4) can be a decent swooper in this field with some luck. SKYZ ABOVE (1) seems to perform best when she gets a fence trip at this track, which she should get here from barrier one. SELECTIONS: PRETTY BASIC (2), BLUE CANNON (3), WINGATE GUY (5), SWIM SUIT (4) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

KARATA ARTEMIS (7) continues to race in great form and will again look to be driven quietly from barrier seven before storming home strongly late. SNOWIEWILLREV (5) won by a big margin when sitting off the speed in a solid tempo last start and may look to replicate that performance here. He clearly has plenty of ability on his day. REMMINGTON (8) is a late back-row runner who hasn’t had much luck of late. He should follow through the expected leader in LYNRYD SKYNRYD (1) and get his chance in the sprint lane, which may be just what he needs to return to form. MR BONDI (4) showed what he’s capable of with a strong second last start and will look to produce a similar performance here, which would have him right in the finish. IMPERIAL LAZ (6) could win this at his best and is another who will be hoping for some good tempo throughout. Selections: KARATA ARTEMIS (7), SNOWIEWILLREV (5), REMMINGTON (8), MR BONDI (4)

A maiden for the two-year-olds, where MYSTERY MAIL (4) should be breaking his duck after a strong string of performances in recent starts, including a painful watch for connections in the Group 2 Dandy Patch last start. VINJETTA (8) continues to run strong races without winning, and expect she may do something similar again here. BACK YA TRUCK UP (5) looks the best of the debutants after some strong trial performances and should look to sit on speed to give himself every chance. VINCENT THE THIRD (1) and IDEN JUST BECAUSE (2) haven’t been far away of late and will look to take advantage of their nice front-row draws to continue earning cheques for their connections. Selections: MYSTERY MAIL (4), VINJETTA (8), BACK YA TRUCK UP (5), VINCENT THE THIRD (1)

The maiden for the older horses, where you would expect the pole marker, ULTIMATE ATOM (1), to start favourite. She hasn’t had the best of luck in her runs thus far and does look like she may get crossed again here, but with any clear running, she clearly has the ability to take out a race of this class. VITESSE (4) should continue to improve with racing and could be suited by the longer trip here after having no luck last start. HARLEY GLENWOOD (7) was a good run despite the form guide showing a fifth placing last start, having sat wide for the final lap and battled on well. BLISSFULL RED (3) and VOODOO RANGER (5) will look to continue their consistent ways, earning cheques for connections in these sorts of races. Selections: ULTIMATE ATOM (1), VITESSE (4), HARLEY GLENWOOD (7), BLISSFULL RED (3)

ATOMIC BLACK (1) will look to take advantage of the favourable draw here over the short distance. He copped pressure early when crossed last week, where they went an extremely fast time over the middle trip. If he backs up well from that hard run, he looks the one to beat. EVERYTHING BUT THE (2) was nearly run down last start in a similar race and possesses good gate speed to find a nice position on speed and be in the finish. Those two look the fastest off the front row, unless KEAYANG FITZY (7) chances his arm from out wide over the short distance, which could very well happen. RAY DAN (3) was a strong winner two starts back in similar grade before galloping away when favourite in the Golden Apple last week. he should be able to slot in early and find a nice position to be running home strongly. SUPER AMERICAN (4), JOHN VINCENT (5) and MONTGOMERY BURNS (6) have all won or put in strong performances at their past starts and will be relying on some good tempo throughout to allow them to run into the finish from their awkward front-row draws. IRON CLAD (8) could be the one at odds, following the pegs from inside the back row. Selections: ATOMIC BLACK (1), RAY DAN (3), EVERYTHING BUT THE (2), IRON CLAD (8)

A lower-class race over the mile, where COLORADO GIRL (3) will look to use her sharp gate speed to cross those two inside her. She somewhat handed up last week when unable to run down the eventual winner, but suspect she may attempt an all-the-way victory here. JAY MILLER (5) is going for three wins on the trot and has been far too tough for them recently in similar grade. If he can find the death seat without doing too much work early from his awkward front-row draw, he could be too strong again. FIVE STAR SHARK (10) and SWEET AMOUR (11) have both put wins on the board lately and should get a nice run through from their back-row draws, while COOLANDCOLLECT (6) could start at overs from his wide front-row gate but may be running home strongly off a good tempo. Selections: JAY MILLER (5), COLORADO GIRL (3), COOLANDCOLLECT (6), SWEET AMOUR (11)

An even field comes together for the 50–55 rated horses over the sprint trip, where IFYOULOVEMELETMEGO (1) will look to make use of her pole draw after drawing awkwardly in recent starts, and put together a sharp mile rate which shes capable of. DEFENCE ATTORNEY (8) should get a nice run through from inside the back row, following out the expected leader and getting his chance. KENYA (9) will no doubt be put into the race from his nice back-row draw and loom as the winner at some stage again. SHOOBEES SPIRIT (11) drops in grade with the claim and could be the one at odds with a strong tempo throughout. EYE SEE AMOUR (2), MY BEAUTIFUL LIFE (3) and REALLY SMARTIE (5) have all been racing well of late and could be in the finish with a nice run in transit. Selections: IFYALOVEMELETMEGO (1), DEFENCE ATTORNEY (8), KENYA (9), SHOOBEES SPIRIT (11)

Quite a strong open-class race, where we see the return of TRIEDTOTELLYA (12), first-up off the back of an Inter Dominion campaign. There looks to be a strong enough tempo for the first lap, with numerous horses possessing good gate speed off the front row, which should allow him to use his sharp speed late if close enough at the top of the straight. SHES ALLABOUTLUV (11) also resumes after competing in the Vicbred series recently and is another who would be suited by a solid tempo throughout and a nice cart into the race, which may come from CUSTOM HARLEY (9), who is normally driven aggressively at some point. ULTIMACTION (5) didn’t handle the standing-start event last week but was impressive when winning the start prior in nice time. She will be looking to find the pegs here, which may be reliant on whether WATERMELON SUGAR (3) decides to take a sit, as he should have enough speed to cross those inside him. MIKI PINS (2) resumes from a break and clearly has plenty of ability on his day, along with handy gate speed when asked. It’s hard to get a gauge on where he’s at, so the market may be the best guide. FREE THINKER (4) was solid enough first-up in the state and should improve from that run, while there are many other handy horses in the field who could be in the finish with luck in transit. MAGICIAN (1) will also look to take advantage of a rare good front-row draw. Selections: TRIEDTOTELLYA (12), SHES ALLABOUTLUV (11), ULTIMACTION (5), CUSTOM HARLEY (9)

A mile race for no more than three-win mares, where STAYZBETTER (2) will look to kick up from her nice draw and attempt an all-the-way victory. She was a little disappointing last week in the Bandbox Prelude but gets her chance here over the short distance. OUR WILLOW (4) looks well graded and possesses sharp enough gate speed to find a position on speed. At her best, she is more than capable of taking this out. SPORT WATCHER (5) has been very consistent of late and will look to find a position on speed with cover. Those runners look the main fancies and class horses of the field from their draws, while ANGEL ROCKS (7) clearly has plenty of ability but will find it tough from the outside front-row draw. Selections: STAYZBETTER (2), OUR WILLOW (4), SPORT WATCHER (5), ANGEL ROCKS (7)

The usual competitive standing-start event for the middle-class pacers, where again manners will be key. DENVER MAN (3) meets the tapes for the first time and, if he steps safely, could be hard to beat sitting on speed. REPETITIVE (4) is always consistent in these types of races and will again look to find the pegs with his good standing-start manners, as will FLEETWOOD ROCK (2), who could run a race at odds with a soft pegs run. SETTEBELLO (5) normally begins sharply and will no doubt be at each-way odds again. ONEHANDONEBOUNCE (8) is among the 10-metre horses who clearly have a class edge over those off the front. They will be relying on a good tempo throughout and a nice run in transit to finish off strongly, with ITSMENOTU (11) possibly looking the best of those chances. Selections: DENVER MAN (3), REPETITIVE (4), ITSMENOTU (11), ONEHANDONEBOUNCE (8)

Expect the last race on the card to be a quickly run mile, where SOHO TIGER LILY (2) will look to use her sharp gate speed to be first to the pegs and run them along at a handy clip. SHADES OF SILK (3) will no doubt sit on speed and ensure a solid tempo throughout, as he usually does, and is suited by the mile distance. BINALONG MATE (1) is first-up in the state and trialled nicely recently. He should get every chance up the sprint lane on his debut for the new stable to be winning off what looks a solid tempo. FAMILY REASONS (4) is racing well and just needs some luck in running to be in the finish from his front-row draw, while LETSGOBRO (8) has put in two performances good enough to run into the placings if gaps appear late. The same could be said for MOVES LIKE A LADY (10), who will no doubt be ducking through the field late, hoping gaps appear, as usual. Selections: BINALONG MATE (1), SOHO TIGERLILY (2), SHADES OF SILK (3), FAMILY REASONS (4) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

WHY NOW (5) was a winner three starts at Ballarat when he defeated NIGHT FLIGHT by a head. He finds an easier race tonight and he looks the one to beat. ITGETSBETTER (3), BROWN EYED KATE (4) and ARZALI (2) are also chances.

MAJESTIC CHEDDAR (6) will provide plenty of each way value here. The draw isn’t ideal but he knows the track well and finds a very winnable race today. SPORTY ROCKS (5) looks like a big danger against this field but she was disappointing here last start. VINCENT ORILEY (1) and GLENFLYER (4) are also chances.

GUNNA ROCK (5) is first up from a spell and he hasn’t had a race start since January 2024. He showed a lot of ability during his first preparation and if he is anywhere near his best tonight then he will be hard to beat. He is risky though after how long he has been off the scene. KATUNTI (2) has race fitness on her side and she has won two of her last three starts. She is worth strong consideration today. MALINI JOH (6) and MARGARITARI (4) are also chances.

ANOTHER WOODS (5) was a last start winner at Ararat when he defeated BATTON ROUGE by a half neck. His stable and his record must be respected today. WOW YOU CAN DANCE (6) has been knocking on the door for another win and looks like a main danger. EASTBRO KAZ (3) and IMAGINATION ORO (4) are also chances.

SMOKIN STREPO (4) has stepped it up another level recently and he has won three of his last five starts. He defeated NORMANDY NUGGET by 2.1 meters at Ararat last start. He will be hard to beat again today. AMERICAN SQUARED (2) looks like the main danger. THE IRISHMAN (3) and LIVERMERE (1) are also chances.

SPOOK CROCKER (6) ran a nice race at Melton on Saturday night and he returns to a track today where he is undefeated. It’s hard to see him getting beaten despite the draw. OCEAN AVENUE (5) looks like a big danger. YANKEE MOJOH (3) and EASTBRO KOZZY (8) are also chances. OVERVIEW: It is an open race to commence the program with several winning chances. CAULONIA TERROR (5) settled midfield and produced a big finish when second behind United last outing. He is awkwardly drawn but should be finishing off strongly again. FLAME BLASTER (1) was held up for a run at a vital stage and should have finished closer at Mildura last outing. He is perfectly drawn to suit his racing pattern and is worth thought. AROCKNROLL JET (4) has improved with each run since resuming and should be nearing a win. He led from the pole position and was run down late when third to Another Woods at Ararat last outing. HELLAVA DEAL (3) did well when resuming as she finished solidly for second behind BAZZAS LEGACY (7) and she should be fitter from that performance so she cannot be discarded. SELECTIONS: CAULONIA TERROR (5), FLAME BLASTER (1), AROCKNROLL JET (4), HELLAVA DEAL (3)

OVERVIEW:CALF PEN (7) is racing in peak form and should prove hard to beat if he has normal luck in running from his awkward draw. He did a lot of work in the run and went down fighting when a brave second behind the smart 2yo pacer Bettorbust two starts ago then made ground from a long way back at his latest fifth. STYLISH GEM (5) settled three back on the markers, went back to the sprint lane and ran home well in restricted room when a close up fourth at Ararat last outing. She is working back to her peak form and is worth an investment. LOUIEVILLE (8) ran his best race for some time when he came out very wide on the home turn and finished off fast for third behind Lord Myrmecia at Mildura last outing. A repeat performance will see him going close to winning under these conditions. OZZIE DAYBREAK (9) was runner up twice prior to a creditable fourth behind Bettorbust, where he picked up ground late. His run of poor barrier draws continues but he is racing well enough to be very competitive. SELECTIONS: CALF PEN (7), STYLISH GEM (5), LOUIEVILLE (8), OZZIE DAYBREAK (9)

OVERVIEW: CAPTAIN PAPRIKA (1) performs best when he is able to lead so he is perfectly drawn to suit his racing pattern. He attempted to lead throughout when second behind Hesastar at Mildura last outing and is capable of going one better now. LESTER (5) boasts a consistent record at Mildura and will strip fitter from his first up sixth at Charlton. He is a versatile pacer and should make his presence felt. LORD MYRMECIA (9) gained the perfect run behind the leader and finished off best when he scored at Mildura last week. He is awkwardly drawn but should be hitting the line strongly. ACCELERE (8) performs best when he is able to lead so being drawn on the second line is a disadvantage. His overall form is very strong however so he must be respected. SELECTIONS: CAPTAIN PAPRIKA (1), LESTER (5), LORD MYRMECIA (9), ACCELERE (8)

OVERVIEW: The former Queensland pacer MY ULTIMATE RUDI (7) was heavily supported at his local debut and was beaten narrowly after attempting to lead throughout. He performed well at the trials prior and is worth following. WATCHING OVER US (4) was running into the race but broke stride and lost his chance on the home turn two starts ago. He finished off nicely at his latest second and should be competitive against this line up. DIAMOND KRUSHER (3) is a fast beginner and is likely to attempt to lead throughout. She drew on the second line and worked through to trail the leader when she finished in third behind The Ladybird at Mildura last outing. She is worth thought from her good draw. SUNSHINE WARRIOR (9) faces a negative swing with the barrier draw but is racing well enough to figure in the finish. BACK: MY ULTIMATE RUDI (7) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: MY ULTIMATE RUDI (7), WATCHING OVER US (4), DIAMOND KRUSHER (3), SUNSHINE WARRIOR (9)

OVERVIEW:DALLAS MIKI (4) is a strong staying type, which pushed forward to find the lead, ran along at a genuine tempo and was too good in the run to the finish at his latest Mildura success. He has won fifteen races on the track and is drawn to give another forward showing. HOT DEAL (8) settled four back on the markers, was held up for a run at a vital stage and finished off well for third behind My Ultimate Jimmy at Mildura last outing. He boasts a strong record on the track and is very versatile so he warrants respect. MAXY WANTS TO PLAY (3) settled three back on the inside and worked home well at his latest second. He continues to build on his consistent record and is worth thought again. THE GOLDEN HOOK (2) has been placed at his past eight starts with four victories. He has only recently risen to this grade but he did battle on solidly behind DALLAS MIKI (4) at his latest performance so he is not without a chance. BACK: DALLAS MIKI (4) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: DALLAS MIKI (4), HOT DEAL (8), MAXY WANTS TO PLAY (3), THE GOLDEN HOOK (2)

OVERVIEW:HAPPY AS CAN BE (3) ran a brave race for third behind Bandit Eyes at Mildura two starts ago then broke stride at the start and made up many lengths when an unlucky sixth last outing. He is a strong South Australian trained pacer and should give a bold showing. GOOD BOOTS BINDI (5) is a handy sprinter, which ran home strongly for a close second behind KEAYANG MOROCCAN (8) last outing. She is likely to settle in the second half of the field but will be dangerous if she can gain the right luck in running. KEAYANG MOROCCAN (8) sustained a long run to win at Mildura last outing. This race is of similar standard so he is worth thought again. LE SPARTACUS (4) is a fast beginner and will appreciate a significant drop back in class for this assignment. He cannot be left out of calculations despite being drawn awkwardly. BACK: HAPPY AS CAN BE (3) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: HAPPY AS CAN BE (3), GOOD BOOTS BINDI (5), KEAYANG MOROCCAN (8), LE SPARTACUS (4)

OVERVIEW: EVA EXPRESS (5) led out then took cover and used the sprint lane when a close second behind Mystic Motiver in a stronger race at Kilmore last outing. She is not as well drawn now but is capable of going one better. CRUEL MISTRESS (2) progressed forward to race without cover and battled on well for second behind Cheddar Cheese at Mildura last outing. She is a maiden from 32 starts but she is getting closer to the money. TAMALIA (1) led out then took cover and appeared to have her chance when third at St Arnaud last outing. She is ideally drawn and should receive a similar trip so she is worth a ticket each way. LITLMAX (8) showed promise when second at Mildura on debut then did things wrong at her next two attempts. She is poorly drawn but is capable of filling a place. BACK: EVA EXPRESS (5) – 1 unit (each way) SELECTIONS: EVA EXPRESS (5), CRUEL MISTRESS (2), TAMALIA (1), LITLMAX (8)

OVERVIEW: R ELEVEN ART (2) has had two starts since June and should be getting fitter. He took on the open class pacers when fourth behind Dallas Miki last outing so he is likely to find this race to be much easier. SHIRELY NOT (7) won twice in succession in October and raced keenly in the leading role when a creditable fourth behind Keayang Moroccan last week. She is versatile and is in peak form so she warrants consideration. MIDNIGHT PIRATE (5) disappointed last outing but his form prior was sound and he possesses early speed so he is worth another chance. SHES POPPY (6) is a speedy mare that is capable of showing up if she gains the right luck in running from her poor draw. SELECTIONS: R ELEVEN ART (2), SHIRLEY NOT (7), MIDNIGHT PIRATE (5), SHES POPPY (6)

OVERVIEW: CAPTAIN MOLLY (6) is resuming since an unplaced effort at Ballarat in June, where she took on a very strong line up. She appears to be much better placed against this class and should go well. SNEAKY PHILTRA (5) bounced back into winning form with a big victory over Mason Dixon Line at Mildura last week. She has won five races at Mildura this season and should he competitive again. MIKIS PLEASURE (7) hasn’t produced her best form for some time but she will appreciate a significant drop back in class for this assignment. Her second behind El Lazzar in a slick mile rate of 1.55.9 three starts ago is a strong form pointer for this event. EAGLEYE (3) was headed off at the start from the pole position and was shuffled back on the markers so she didn’t have much luck last outing. She was placed in her three attempts prior and is worth another chance. SELECTIONS: CAPTAIN MOLLY (6), SNEAKY PHILTRA (5), MIKIS PLEASURE (7), EAGLEYE (3)

OVERVIEW: KELLYS COMMOTION (5) is a former New South Wales trained pacer, which finished off fairly well for third at her Victorian debut then made ground from a long way back when fifth at Charlton. She will appreciate her easiest assignment to date and should make her presence felt. BETTY CAROLINE (1) couldn’t go the frantic early tempo and got a long way out of her ground early before working into third late when on debut. She is better drawn for this assignment and should have improved by the experience so she cannot be left out calculations. THE MIGHTY CAESAR (6) began quickly to find the lead, took cover and battled on fairly well for fourth on debut. It is a slow front line so he should be able to gain a forward position early despite his wide draw and he is worth an investment. SANTA CASA LEVI (4) hasn’t produced his best form in three starts this preparation but gets his chance to improve under these conditions. MUFARO (7) broke stride and lost his chance when unplaced on debut. He is capable of showing improvement if he delivers a fool proof display. SELECTIONS: KELLYS COMMOTION (5), BETTY CAROLINE (1), THE MIGHTY CAESAR (6), SANTA CASA LEVI (4)

OVERVIEW: Just the three runners in the APG feature for the 3yo fillies. ORLANDO VEYRON (1) is the clear standout based on her race experience and placings behind high-quality trotters in her age group. She has sound manners and good gate speed to lead and take control here. She was a winner last start, beating the only danger in this. The only way she doesn't win is if she beats herself with bad manners, but she should be prohibitive odds. THE WOOL BROKER (2) is the only other runner with race experience and ran 3rd to the top pick at her last start. She was a winner three runs back in slow time at Geelong. Considering she's likely to be on the leader's back, with what's anticipated to be a clear lack of pace or pressure, she'll be relying on the polemarker not being on her game. WHIRLWIN (3) is an NSW visitor making her debut on the back of seven trials, where she's been beaten by sizeable margins and has often done things wrong. She's from an astute stable, which could present some upside, but I'm happy to dismiss her at this stage. SELECTIONS:ORLANDO VEYRON (1), THE WOOL BROKER (2), WHIRLWIN (3)

OVERVIEW:SEW HOPEFULL (1) is a 3yo filly and a 24-start maiden, but all indications from her last five starts, particularly her latest outing, suggest a win is very close. She was able to lead from the outside barrier at Geelong and showed plenty of guts, only narrowly beaten by the long odds-on favourite. She can lead these over the short trip and potentially provide legendary Lance Justice with his first winning drive since his comeback last week. BEAU BECA (8) looks likely to catch her back, map well over the short trip and get her chance along the passing lane. She's been racing consistently in her past few starts, and this presents as her most suitable set-up in some time. SURETHING (4) is a 2yo filly taking on more experienced types but has displayed some ability in her four career runs, winning once and missing a place only once. This isn't an overly strong race despite her inexperience. GOZO SWEET (3) should be fitter here second up from a break and was a winner last preparation against similar types. She should map well to be in the mix. BAD GRANDMA (2), LOOK AT HER (5) and ROCK POSTER (10) all have claims for the minor money. SELECTIONS:SEW HOPEFULL (1), BEAU BECA (8), SURETHING (4), GOZO SWEET (3)

OVERVIEW: Two heats leading into a final, with last week's Geelong race looking the better reference on time. MY ATLANTIS (3) won the Geelong race and really had to earn it, coming from last and sustaining a three-wide run for the final lap in solid enough time. He's been a lightly raced 7yo, but he's enjoying his best season and is going for three in a row here. The soft draw helps offset his lack of tactical speed, allowing him to come with one run late and be strong over the final 100m. MONSIEUR FLAMEL (6) raced in both heats, coming off the speed to finish 3rd before leading at Geelong, where he looked to have every chance as an odds-on favourite, only to be run down right on the post. The lead may be there again, so he'll be in it for a long way. LIKE A GAZELLE (4) could represent some value as the likely map horse, given she can show speed and take cover to get her chance along the sprint lane. She narrowly missed here at Melton when adopting those tactics. BREATHE EASY (7) has a tough draw but may float forward to get in front of some key rivals and has an SP profile worth respecting. SPORTS NARRATOR (10) and COOL STORY (11) were both heat winners here at Melton, but this sets up very differently with the tough draws they must overcome. They'll need the tempo on to come with one run. OUR BELLA LUCIA (2) and QUICK CRUNCH (9) have soft trailing draws that could see them improve on previous efforts, but I prefer them for the minor money. BACK: MY ATLANTIS (3) – 2.5 units (win) SELECTIONS:MY ATLANTIS (3), MONSIEUR FLAMEL (6), LIKE A GAZELLE (4), COOL STORY (11)

OVERVIEW: Another series of heats leading into a final, this time for the trotters. DOSSIER (9) returned to form, spanking them in her heat from the same draw, where she trailed through to map well before running away from the field. To be fair, the performance looked better to the eye than on the clock. Chris Alford sticking with her is a big plus. QUAKE PROOF (8) is at his best when he can coil up after doing no work and let down with one run when the others are getting tired. That was the case in his heat victory, where he came from last and swept wide. He'll have to navigate a passage this time but can hit the line when the breaks come. JAKARTA (11) ran well in both heats and will appreciate what looks to be a speedy front line to work into the race strongly late. That speed on the front line comes from CHINSKI (1), DESERT ASSASIN (2), KIMBERLYS TREE (3), APRIL SUN (5), JOE LOU (6) and LEANNE LEEANN (7), who all regularly press forward or like to lead in their races. There could be plenty of jostling for that position, making the map difficult to predict and their winning chances equally uncertain. BACK: DOSSIER (9) – 2.5 units (win) SELECTIONS:DOSSIER (9), QUAKE PROOF (8), JAKARTA (11), LEANNE LEEANN (7)

OVERVIEW:JILLIBY UTAH (3) finds a suitable race and looks ready to win based on what he's displayed over the past couple of months, where he's taken on stronger types and hasn't been too far away. He has good early gate speed, which he showed last start at Geelong, only to be double-crossed before finishing solidly when clear. He can lead these over the short trip, and Ewa Justice, one of the leading drivers this season, jumps on. CHARLIE SEBASTIAN (10) has shown good ability, finishing runner-up on five occasions from nine starts, but he was a little plain last time, which is a concern, and he does have a tricky draw to overcome. His best is good enough. RETRO FIT (8) found the line well last time for a 2nd at Melton in a race many of these contested. She has a soft draw and can finish strongly with the right tempo. DYGNALI (2) has a solid SP profile, a soft draw and a good driver to help improve on recent outings. WICKED ONE (1) needs to lift slightly but looks to map very well, so could be a knockout chance with an economical trip. BACK: JILLIBY UTAH (3) – 2.5 units (win) SELECTIONS:JILLIBY UTAH (3), CHARLIE SEBASTIAN (10), RETRO FIT (8), WICKED ONE (1)

OVERVIEW:KING SAINT (8) could be a big improver here and represent some value, dropping well back in class and finally appearing to get a suitable set-up. He draws behind a runner who always likes to lead, with the likelihood that he can catch his back over the short trip and get his chance along the passing lane. The last time he raced in this ratings band, he was a winner. HAPPILY (2) found the going a bit too slick last time in a good-quality race at Geelong, where she had every chance to finish 4th. Her form prior was very good, running well even when taking on some smart ones, but when she dropped back to a suitable grade, she was a winner. She's right in it. HELLOVATIME (1) runs his best races when able to lead, and although he's done so recently, it's been against tougher opposition than he meets here. His overall record this season is good in similar conditions. PISTOL PEARCE (6) was my best bet last Saturday night at Melton, but on face value, he was disappointing and had every chance. His two runs prior were excellent if you're prepared to forgive that effort. POPCORNFRIDAY (3) is a recent Melton winner, so can't be dismissed, while any betting moves for INVITATION ONLY (4) need to be respected off some decent trials. He returns to his former stable, where he won better races at this track. BACK: KING SAINT (8) – 2.5 units (win) SELECTIONS:KING SAINT (8), HAPPILY (2), HELLOVATIME (1), PISTOL PEARCE (6)

OVERVIEW:PRECIOUS BELLE (3) is a mare who always needs luck and the right tempo, as she maps negatively and likes to come with one run. As a result, she often races better at this track, where there's usually a more genuine speed than what she can face at tighter provincial tracks. There's a strong likelihood the leaders won't be able to put down a slick last half, so swoopers are favoured. ARE WEASLEY (9) goes to a back-row draw after some solid efforts when able to map favourably. His overall form is better than most, so he warrants respect. ROBLEN RANGER (8) was disappointing last start, but if you're prepared to overlook that effort, his form prior was good for a race of this calibre. He maps behind the likely leader and can finish off well. FLIGHT LOUTENANT (7) comes out of a winnable race last time, where he still did things wrong but was able to score. He gets no map favours here, but an astute trainer/driver combination commands respect. PICKLE IT (1) looks the leader but needs to improve, while AVIERO (5) and HURRICANE HOOLEY (6) are grinding types who are often thereabouts in these races for the minor money. SELECTIONS:PRECIOUS BELLE (3), ARE WEASLEY (9), ROBLEN RANGER (8), FLIGHT LOUTENANT (7)

OVERVIEW:WAR ZONE (9) is first up here and has proven himself to be a handy 3yo, delivering some big wins, albeit when he's been able to lead. That was the case at this track earlier in the year, where he put a space on his rivals, some of whom he meets again here. He's had one winning trial leading into this, and while fitness and the draw are against him, the anticipated early tempo and his good record with Justice are positives. TUKARUA (6) is a fast beginner and was terrific in winning first up, defeating a subsequent winner who has since franked the form. She was also a winner at this track from the back row, beating some rivals she faces here. The only concern is the map, as although she has speed, so too do several others drawn to her inside. YANKEE GAMBLER (1) is always honest at this level, but he's not known for producing a sharp sprint at the end of his races. That makes the draw a slight negative, as he looks likely to be crossed. MIDNIGHT MOJO (4) is consistent in these types of races, aided by her tactical speed to find a suitable trip here. She's honest enough to consider. WOODLEA DIEGO (3) is a quick beginner who will be looking for the top end, as will ROSBERG (5), who had every chance last Sunday at Cranbourne when able to lead. SNACK LOVER (8) gets a soft run and could be the one to flash late if they overcook things. It's an open race. SELECTIONS:WAR ZONE (9), TUKARUA (6), YANKEE GAMBLER (1), MIDNIGHT MOJO (4)

OVERVIEW:OUR TRUE COLOURS (8) finds the most suitable race she's been in for a long time, and what stands out is her record at Melton compared to the opposition. She boasts four wins at the track and plenty of experience in better-quality races. She's an opportunist, so the soft draw is no disadvantage, particularly with the accomplished John Caldow navigating a path when the others are tiring. TASTE IT (9) is known for liking to lead, but she was a winner two runs back coming off the pace, which is particularly encouraging considering the depth of opposition. The trailing draw should see her map well enough to work into the race at the right time. ENABLE ME (7) has a tough draw to overcome but looks well suited on the ratings scale and is more capable of running slicker times than the majority of the opposition. DOT BALL (6) doesn't win out of turn, but similar to the ones already mentioned, looks to have found the weakest race for some time and has the potential to be more map-positive than most. ROCKNROLL RAMBO (4) locked wheels at a key stage last time and has minor claims for first fours with the right run, along with IMAGUNNARESTNGO (2) and GOODTIME MAE (5). SELECTIONS:OUR TRUE COLOURS (8), TASTE IT (9), ENABLE ME (7), DOT BALL (6)

OVERVIEW: Exact race conditions as the previous, where the form is nothing to write home about. FREAK OUT (8) has performed well at this track in the past and often gets caught doing plenty of work in his races. This draw allows him to spend fewer tickets early and save them for late when the others are weakening. ICANMOTOR (3) narrowly missed last start and gets a more favourable draw now. Leedham is a driver who wins with regularity at this track, which is a positive factor. ALLHEARTNOHEIGHT (7) can be a little hard to catch but has performances at this track that stack up in a race of this calibre. Despite the wide draw, she comes into calculations. SIR CANDY CLOUD (1) can take advantage of this draw and look for the lead, which is advantageous over the short trip. He's yet to place from seven attempts at this track, however. ALCATRAZ GIRL (4) was able to lead and looked to have every chance last start at Shepparton. She's map-dependent, but keep her safe. SELECTIONS:FREAK OUT (8), ICANMOTOR (3), SIR CANDY CLOUD (1), ALLHEARTNOHEIGHT (7)

OCTOBER RACKETEER (1) has good gate speed and should be able to drive through and lead this race in the early stages of this race. He led two starts ago and was able to hold off the late challenge of Last Call who had the perfect run on his back. ASHLEE NITRO (7) should get a good run through behind the likely leader in this race. He secured a similar run two starts ago and finished best there to beat Charlie Chuckles over the 2040 there at this track. She looks hard to hold out. SAME OLD DEVIL (9) sat without cover and may just not have been suited in that position when fading late. He was running on strongly into second behind Im Busted can looks well placed again in this race. HOLME BOY (8) was well beaten over the 2040 in a race taken out by The Torque Effect. He should get a good run on the pegs behind the speed this time and can be running into the money late. SELECTIONS: OCTOBER RACKETEER (1), ASHLEE NITRO (7), SAME OLD DEVIL (9), HOLME BOY (8) SUGGESTED BET: OCTOBER RACKETEER (1) to win.

ART OF ROCK (2) draws favourably in this race and may be able to work to the lead in the early stages of the race. He sat without cover over this trip three starts ago and was able to battle away well for third behind Sheez Got Torque. MY SCIMITAR (10) secured a good run off the speed last time out and was running on strongly there behind Holme Boy who was able to lead all the way. He should secure a similar run off the speed and should be running on strongly late in this company. SNIP OF BEAUTY (1) should get a good run behind the speed in this race. She got back off the speed last time out and was running on late into fifth in a race taken out by PLAYING FOR KEEPS (7). PLAYING FOR KEEPS (7) appears suited in this race getting a soft run behind the speed. She secured a good run close to the speed and was able to run over the top late to score there. SELECTIONS: ART OF ROCK (2), MY SCIMITAR (10), SNIP OF BEAUTY (1), PLAYING FOR KEEPS (7) SUGGESTED BET: ART OF ROCK (2) to win.

LITTLEMICKEY (1) was able to lead and score a nice win two starts ago at this track. He should be able to drive through and lead again in this race and should be hard to beat again if he can go somewhere near his latest win. ATULA (9) was able to sit without cover last time out and score an impressive win rating good time there at this track. He draws the back row again but can be put into the race at some stage and should be hard to hold out. WINDY HILL WALLY (7) should get a good run through in this race behind the speed and looks well graded in this race. He secured a good run on the pegs last time out and wasn’t beaten too far there in fourth. KINGSBURY (2) was able to secure a favourable run last time out behind the leader at Marburg and was able to sprint past his stablemate Charlie Chuckles to score. He should settle close enough in the run and can be running on late. SELECTIONS: LITTLEMICKEY (1), ATULA (9), WINDY HILL WALLY (7), KINGSBURY (2) SUGGESTED BET: LITTLEMICKEY (1) to win.

DOOO DONT THINK (1) should be able to drive through and lead in the early stages of this race from a perfect draw. He secured a good run last time out and wasn’t beaten too far finishing sixth. He looks hard to beat. TACKAS LAST DANCE (7) should get a good run through in this race behind the speed. She got back in the run last time out and couldn’t get into the race late which was dominated by runners up on speed or on the pegs. HIGHVIEW SADLER (4) is likely to be shuffled back a touch in the early stages of this race. He secured a good run last time out in a slightly stronger race and wasn’t beaten far there behind Vodka En Ice. SUBLTE CHAY (6) draws wide in this race and may be shuffled back a long way which could see him relying on the race being run to suit. He did some work last time out and wasn’t beaten too far there in fourth. SELECTIONS: DOOO DONT THINK (1), TACKAS LAST DANCE (7), HIGHVIEW SADLER (4), SUBLTE CHAY (6) SUGGESTED BET: DOOO DONT THINK (1) to win.

PERFECT FEELING (1) has good gate speed and should be able to drive through and lead in the early stages of this race. He led three starts ago and was just run down late there finishing second behind Rosarito. WANDARY DELIGHT (4) appears likely to be shuffled back a touch early in this race from a slightly awkward draw. She got back in the run last time out and was running on nicely late into fourth. She can be running on late again. SHES BEWITCHED (7) has had a month between runs which could see her needing the run in this race. She does appear likely to get a favourable run through early behind a gate speed horse and can be dangerous if ready to go on return. DIGBY JOY (5) is likely to be shuffled back in this race from a wide draw. She secured a good run on the pegs two starts ago and was running on late into second there. SELECTIONS: PERFECT FEELING (1), WANDARY DELIGHT (4), SHES BEWITCHED (7), DIGBY JOY (5) SUGGESTED BET: PERFECT FEELING (1) to win.

THE LUVBUG (2) was driven aggressively over the 2040 two starts ago and was able to prove too good there leading all the way and rating good time. She should be able to work forward and find the lead again in this race and should be hard to run down. JIVE MASTER (7) drew poorly last time out at Albion Park when shuffled back before running on late into sixth. He draws much more favourably this time and should secure a soft run off the speed and can be running on late. DIGBY DEVIL (1) was able to secure the right run recently just off the speed and finished strongly to run down The Torque Effect who has since run well. He has a good draw and should settle close enough and can finish in the money again. REAL TIN TIN (5) secured a good run behind the leader last time out and was running on well late into second behind stablemate Our Ultimate Jessy. He may be shuffled back this time and can be running on late. SELECTIONS: THE LUVBUG (2), JIVE MASTER (7), DIGBY DEVIL (1), REAL TIN TIN (5) SUGGESTED BET: THE LUVBUG (2) to win.

SIMPLY INSPIRING (1) was badly impeded by a tiring runner last time out losing plenty of ground there before storming into fourth late. She appeared to leave the gate reasonably on debut and if she could lead in this race she would likely be very hard to run down. MISTER CEE CEE (5) trialled up nicely recently finishing third behind Jakob in reasonable time at Albion Park. He draws poorly in this race and may be shuffled back early but should be running on well late in this race. BILLY IDEAL (6) despite doing a few things wrong in the run was able to run well for second behind Commanche Bling last time out. He is likely to have derived good benefit from the outing and can run well again in this race. AMERICANGODDYJUJON (2) secured the right type of run on the pegs last time out behind the speed and was able to run on late into third there behind Commanche Bling. With a similar run she can run into the money again. SELECTIONS: SIMPLY INSPIRING (1), MISTER CEE CEE (5), BILLY IDEAL (6), AMERICANGODDYJUJON (2) SUGGESTED BET: SIMPLY INSPIRING (1) to win.

WAVE OF DELIGHT (4) burned to the lead last time out and set a strong tempo before running second to Scar Struck in fast time. His latest effort finishing second in a race the winner rated 1.52.6 looks clearly the best form and he should be very hard to beat in this race. LUCKY JESS (2) led last time out at this track and was just run down late by Atula who sat without cover there. She draws favourably again in this race and should be able to lead before having options from there. CLAUDES DESIRE (3) made a break early last time out taking himself completely out of play there at Albion Park which leaves him ODM for this race. He has run good time in QLD when finishing second to Skip To Me Lou and with the right run can be thereabouts again. SKYWARD SHUFFLE (5) ran well in a recent trial albeit in slow time behind Keayang Moscato. She is likely to be shuffled back and can be running on late. SELECTIONS: WAVE OF DELIGHT (4), LUCKY JESS (2), CLAUDES DESIRE (3), SKYWARD SHUFFLE (5) SUGGESTED BET: WAVE OF DELIGHT (4) to win.
